messages:
michael: Kicking off release window for model-route v2. Soft-enable feature flag 'cohort_gating_v2' starting now. Ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m (10m stages + soak). Start time 02:00 UTC. Please ack and call out any blockers or special rollback criteria.

shweta: ack. I'll own metrics. Watching p95, error rate, and eval-set diffs. We should pin to v2.1.0-canary for the cohort. If p95 +150ms or error rate +0.5% trigger rollback.

raj: ack from infra side. @oncall-sre please take handoff for telemetry during the window. One ask: last time sticky sessions caused session drift — do we pin session affinity?

michael: good catch. We'll set session-affinity=cohort_id header for the rollout. If we observe drift we'll flip sticky=false and force-unpin. deploy-bot, please start the staged rollout for EU cohort first.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Triggered rollout: feature=cohort_gating_v2 percent=5 cohort_selector=(geo=EU) model_version=v2.1.0-canary shards=1/20. Expected change window: 10m stage + 5m soak. Next status update in ~10m.

oncall-sre: Taking watch. Running smoke queries now and will run the 200-seed eval set every 5m. My rollback thresholds: eval_regression >1.2% OR p95 > +150ms sustained over 2 windows OR error_rate +0.75% -> rollback.

michael: config snippet for ops reference:
```
feature_flag: cohort_gating_v2
stages:
  - percent: 5
    duration_s: 600
  - percent: 25
    duration_s: 600
  - percent: 100
    duration_s: 600
rollback_triggers:
  - name: p95_latency
    delta_ms: 150
  - name: error_rate
    delta_pct: 0.5
  - name: eval_regression
    delta_pct: 1.0
pin_duration: 3600  # seconds to keep version pinned post-rollout
```

shweta: also enabling KV prefix cache for model v2 to help tail latency. I'll flip cache_warm=true as we ramp.

deploy-bot: Update: 5% stage complete (1/20 shards). Telemetry snapshot: p95 +40ms, error_rate delta +0.02%, eval_regression 0.0%. No blockers.

shweta: nice. Proceed to 25% in ~2m if no regressions. :thumbsup:

raj: noted about pin duration. Reminder: after 1h we should remove explicit pin so autoscaler can rebalance. I'll add that to the runbook.

michael: rollback procedure (ops runbook):
- Quick toggle: disable feature flag in Console -> cohort_gating_v2 = false
- CLI: `/deploybot rollback cohort_gating_v2 --to-percent 0 --force-unpin`
- If deploy rollback needed: `/deploybot rollback-deploy model-route v2.1.0-canary --to-version v1.8.3`
Call out to infra for any capacity ops.

oncall-sre: If I see p95 > +150ms or eval_regression >1.2% for two consecutive checks, I'll execute the CLI rollback and ping #incidents.

deploy-bot: Update: 25% stage started. Telemetry: p95 +60ms, error_rate +0.1%, eval_regression +0.3% (within thresholds). Rolling out 5/20 shards.

shweta: good. Proceed to 100% on green in ~12m. I'll keep KV cache warm and watch token-level costs during the ramp.

michael: FYI if anyone needs to abort fast: use `deploy-bot abort-rollout cohort_gating_v2` which disables and forces drain in <30s. Also we should annotate release notes: "model-route v2.1.0-canary — soft cohort gating, EU-first, soft-enable".

oncall-sre: calling out one small quality check: will run end-to-end prompt set (50 prompts) at 50% stage for manual inspection. If any unacceptable hallucination increase flagged by reviewer, rollback immediately.

raj: added a postmortem checklist entry: verify session-affinity header removed if rollback and ensure cache invalidation for v2 keys.

deploy-bot: Update: 100% rollout started (20/20 shards ramping). Current telemetry snapshot: p95 +80ms, error_rate +0.15%, eval_regression +0.4%. No rollback triggered. Rollout ETA complete in ~8m.

shweta: monitoring looks green. Leaving a note to revisit cost implications during next standup.

michael: all good — full rollout expected complete by 02:40 UTC. Leaving pin in place for 1h as planned, then auto-unpin. Closing thread unless anyone calls a blocker. :tada:

raj: thanks everyone, acked and standing down.

oncall-sre: ack. Will escalate if thresholds breach.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. feature=cohort_gating_v2 percent=100 model_version=v2.1.0-canary. Logs: /logs/deploys/1718812345/summary.

michael: adding brief release note to docs and marking this window closed. Thanks folks.
